# Ledgebay

> > Ledgebay offers premium paint-by-number kits for adults, combining creative relaxation with therapeutic wellness benefits and customizable artistic expression.

Ledgebay is an online retailer specializing in high-quality paint-by-numbers kits for adults in various sizes and styles. The site features curated collections, custom options, beginner guides, and a community gallery showcasing customer artwork.
